remarks: Welcome to 13 West Washington! A fantastic opportunity for an owner occupant or investor!  This one bedroom ranch apartment is updated and ready for someone to enjoy all the joys of downtown Stamford living. Restaurants, bars, parks, shopping, UCONN, Library, Hospital, train and major highway are all within a short distance. Low common charges and taxes make this unit very affordable. Updates in the unit include new flooring in bedroom, new tiles in kitchen floor and wall, new granite countertop, brand new apliances- refrigerator, stove & microwave oven, two new window air conditioners and high end Vertical blinds. The dining area has new modern light fixture. The complex provides on-site coin laundry, private storage in basement, assigned parking and plenty of visitor parking. Buy today and be in by the holidays!
